summary: CABAL Online is ESTsoft's long-running action MMORPG, with preservation tied to regional live-service clients, server/operator state, classes, and event versions.

entries.title: Cabal Online
entries.definitive_edition: Current official regional PC client, with server/operator/build documented

emulation.notes: Live Windows PC client; archival fidelity depends on server state.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official client connected to documented regional server state

primary.why: CABAL Online is an MMORPG with region-specific operators and changing service state. The archive route should use the currently available official regional PC client and record server, patch, character class, and event state.
primary.how_to_play: Use an official regional PC client. Record operator, region, client/build, server, class, level, nation, dungeon/mission, party/PvP state, monetization/event state, and whether mobile/Combo variants were excluded.

secondary.exclusive_content: Different service branches and mobile adaptation
secondary.why: They can diverge from the PC MMORPG baseline.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Korean and later regional MMORPG service context.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC current regional official client
all_releases.fidelity: Live current-service route with patch/server state.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service state differs by region/operator and can change with patches, events, and migrations.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region, service operator, patch, event, and monetization state.
